webex.reason: Webex plugin 0.1.3 calls registerHttpHandler, which is absent from this OpenClaw baseline. A compatible plugin must be qualified before setup can enable Webex.

qualification: These pinned interfaces are adapter baselines, not proof of a completed installation. Native config validation and each selected installation's verification tiers are still required. Unknown versions need a reviewed adapter update.

in2n-production.reason: The legacy production preparation changes shared host resources. It is unavailable for separate-claw setup until an installation-scoped adapter and production controls are qualified. Testing Risk uses the scoped n2n and protocol adapters.
